<issue>
PropertyChanged no longer works
### Describe the bug

Calling `OnPropertyChanged` to update the UI so it matches the underlying property no longer works.

**Xaml:**
```
<CheckBox Content="Bound to IsChecked"
        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
        VerticalAlignment="Center"
        IsChecked="{Binding IsChecked, Mode=OneWay}" />
<TextBlock Text="{Binding IsChecked, StringFormat='Actual IsChecked value: {0}'}" />
<Button Content="Raise property changed"
        Command="{Binding RaisePropertyChangedCommand}" />
```

**VM:**
```
private bool _isChecked;
public bool IsChecked
{
        get => _isChecked;
        set
        {
                _isChecked = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
        }
}
public RelayCommand RaisePropertyChangedCommand { get; }

public MainWindowViewModel()
{
        RaisePropertyChangedCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteRaisePropertyChanged);
}

private void ExecuteRaisePropertyChanged()
{
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsChecked));
}
```

### To Reproduce

1. Run the [test repository](https://github.com/mohdimas/AvaloniaBindingTest/tree/main)
2. Check the checkbox so the UI is checked. But as it's one-way binding, so the underlying property is not updated
3. Click the button to call `OnropertyChanged`.
4. The expected behavior should update the UI to match the underlying property but it doesnt work

![Kapture 2024-12-03 at 11 19 34](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f371a564-e68d-4e8e-93be-45b81de4c99a)


### Expected behavior

On Avalonia 11.0.13 it still works ([TestRepo](https://github.com/mohdimas/AvaloniaBindingTest/tree/avalonia-11.0.13))

![Kapture 2024-12-03 at 11 12 41](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/50f4c9da-5c3d-477f-bf61-59720e64352c)


### Avalonia version

11.1.0 and above including latest nightly build

### OS

macOS

### Additional context

_No response_

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

content.content: {"summary":"The skip check that suppresses the push is in UntypedBindingExpressionBase.PublishValue, which BindingExpression calls. It is not in the INPC plugin or the expression nodes. PublishValue compares the new source value with the binding's cached last-published `_value`, not with the target's current value. After a local target change (e.g. CheckBox IsChecked), the cache is stale. An unchanged source value then gives hasValueChanged=false, so the sink is told nothing changed and the target is not refreshed.","findings":["src/Avalonia.Base/Data/Core/UntypedBindingExpressionBase.cs:427 is the likely culprit: `var hasValueChanged = value != UnchangedValue && !TypeUtilities.IdentityEquals(value, GetValue(), TargetType);`. GetValue() (line 125-130) returns the cached `_value`, not the actual target value.","UntypedBindingExpressionBase.cs:430-432: `_value` is only updated if hasValueChanged. Line 439 then calls `_sink.OnChanged(this, hasValueChanged, hasErrorChanged, GetValueOrDefault(), _error)`. When hasValueChanged is false and there is no error, the sink is told the value did not change, so the target is not re-set. I did not read the sink code to confirm this last step.","Plugins/InpcPropertyAccessorPlugin.cs:128-135: the weak-event handler `IWeakEventSubscriber<PropertyChangedEventArgs>.OnEvent` is the real PropertyChanged handler. If the property name matches or is empty, it sets `_eventRaised = true` and calls SendCurrentValue(). There is no `OnPropertyChanged` method in this file.","Plugins/InpcPropertyAccessorPlugin.cs:176-185: SendCurrentValue reads `Value` and calls PublishValue(value) with no equality check. SetValue (lines 122-142) also calls SendCurrentValue when no event was raised.","ExpressionNodes/PropertyAccessorNode.cs:94 (OnValueChanged) calls ExpressionNode.SetValue(newValue). ExpressionNodes/ExpressionNode.cs:211-216 (SetValue) sets `_value` and calls Owner.OnNodeValueChanged unconditionally, with no equality check.","BindingExpression.cs:185-215 (OnNodeValueChanged): for the leaf node in a non-OneWayToSource mode it calls ConvertAndPublishValue(value, error). ConvertAndPublishValue (lines 405-453) applies the converter, TargetNullValue, StringFormat and FallbackValue, then calls PublishValue(value, error) at line 453. It has no equality check of its own.","BindingExpression.cs:310 has `IdentityEquals(LeafNode.Value, value, type) && ErrorType == None`. This is in the target-to-source write path (WriteValueToSource), so it is unrelated to the reported issue.","Possible fix: in PublishValue, force the notification when the source raised an explicit change event. Alternatively, compare against the target's current value, or invalidate the cached `_value` when the target changes locally (see OnTargetPropertyChanged, BindingExpression.cs:476)."],"confidence":0.8}

content.text:
I changed `PublishValue` in `UntypedBindingExpressionBase.cs` so a source change notification always pushes the value to the target. I haven't built it or run any tests.

**Cause:** the binding compared the new source value with its own cached last-published value, not with what the target currently holds. After you tick the checkbox locally, the cache is stale. `OnPropertyChanged` then publishes the same value as before, the comparison says "unchanged", and the target is never refreshed.

**Fix:** `hasValueChanged` is now true for any value that isn't `UnchangedValue`. The old `IdentityEquals` check against the cache is gone.

**Side effects:** every notification now sets the target again, even when nothing changed. I expect this to be harmless for TwoWay bindings, because setting a target to the value it already has changes nothing. Existing tests that count how many times a value is pushed could be affected. A narrower fix would limit the forced push to explicit `PropertyChanged` events, but I didn't try that.
